content:
[Thinking]
**Clarifying the Hatter's portrayal**

The user asked in Russian about the Hatter in "Alice Through the Looking Glass." I want to confirm they're referring to the 2016 Tim Burton film. Johnny Depp played the Mad Hatter in that version. There’s also a 2010 film where he played the same character, so I should mention that too. I'll keep it simple and provide the English name "Mad Hatter" along with the Russian title for clarity.
[/Thinking]

В фильме «Алиса в Зазеркалье» (Alice Through the Looking Glass, 2016) роль Безумного Шляпника (Mad Hatter) исполнил Джонни Депп.
